goal: Run the controller-selected PyTorch Jacobian capability through ConstraintBox and its deterministic Mini-LevOS tool and gate flow.
deliverable: A verified local receipt for one controller-challenged torch.func.jacrev operation with positive, wrong-value, and boundary controls.
in_scope: Run the fixed pytorch-jacobian-v1 capability only.
Capture the deterministic request assessment, personalized context, Mini-LevOS flow ledger, and external capability receipt.
Verify the nested capability artifacts before reporting the bounded result.
out_of_scope: Treating PyTorch or the full simulation estate as ConstraintBox core.
Using an LLM to select the worker, gate, transition, or disposition.
Claiming engine readiness, CR truth, scientific proof, release, or canonical promotion.

assumptions.statement: The local ConstraintBox tree is a candidate working tree whose passing receipt is not canonical admission.

evidence_required: The request is accepted only when the deterministic finite, Z3, and CVC5 request checks agree.
The controller-owned PyTorch capability runs a real torch.func.jacrev operation and records positive, wrong-value, and boundary controls.
The Mini-LevOS tool-to-gate flow and its hash-chained ledger validate before a bounded capability result is reported.
claim_boundary: This request can establish only one local controller-selected PyTorch Jacobian capability receipt with bounded controls; it cannot establish release, full engine readiness, CR truth, science, hostile-code containment, or canonical status.
unknowns: Whether a later generic proposal flow can safely consume this receipt without weakening the Mini-LevOS authority boundary.
communication_needs: State exactly what operation ran and which deterministic gate verified it.
Keep the external tool result separate from release or truth claims.
